scope: Actual multi-thread process-state recovery and explicit PDF trust-anchor checks, with full prior-feature regression; no universal or cloud integration claim

new_implementation.checkpoint_thread_group: The native pinned Linux checkpoint API now admits a bounded same-login process with 1..16 threads, verifies all members stop before capture, preserves original TIDs on restore, and requires every restored member identity/state to match before explicit resume. Children, external peers and incompatible devices remain unqualified.
new_implementation.pdf_trust_anchors: pdf_security accepts optional paired trust_store_file/trust_store_sha256. A bounded public PEM bundle is policy-checked and pinned, transferred natively for remote files, and used for offline current-time OpenSSL chain verification. Default trust stores are excluded. Intact CMS bytes and trust under these explicit anchors are reported independently.
new_implementation.calendar_fix_deployed: The earlier committed VALUE date/time correction is included in the actual running release and passed full installed-protocol 1900/1904 date, TEXT conditional-format and ordinary-time tests.

power_lifecycle.hardware_power_control_discovery: Searched available integrations for Home Assistant/remote power/PDU/IPMI; no matching connected physical power-control capability was returned. No connector was installed or credentials changed.
power_lifecycle.interpretation: Actual prior S5 shutdown/wake evidence is retained and current boot/services were independently read. Main controller and later X230 preflights still had non-test workloads. No busy machine was powered off; S5 is not removal of both AC and battery.

hosted_ci.source: GitHub REST job endpoint observed completed/success; latest evidence/test-only follow-up needs separate exact-head observation

known_scope_limits: Native process restoration remains same-boot/same-host Linux with compatible files and process-internal pipes; CRIU is pinned only for x230. It does not transfer arbitrary DC userspace buffers, external socket peers, GPU contexts or whole process trees.

Controller physical reboot and mechanical AC/battery removal still lack a qualified idle/recovery window or independent power control. No virtual-machine reset or another hosts S5 event is substituted.
Inode patching remains Linux same-size <=65536-byte non-atomic mutation; immutable/executable capability flags and arbitrary atomic resize with all hard-link identities are not promised.

PDF caller-root chain verification does not establish revocation, trusted signing time, certificate-purpose/EKU or DocMDP compliance. Existing signatures never sign changed content. No real signing key or user password was used.
Complex workbook coverage includes tested names/shared/fixed-array/calendar semantics, not external workbook/macros/volatile or unconstrained dynamic-spill and Microsoft Excel engine identity.
ChatGPT/workspace/custom-app/tunnel integration is still deliberately last and untouched.

A combined source/result metadata read was refused by this session safety check and was not retried.
No private CRIU images, process memory, real passwords, certificate private keys or provider credentials were exported.
